description: Flightpath: records every Claude Code session live, draws the journey as a map, and coaches the next session.
name: @flightpath/flightpath

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node build.mjs && pnpm --filter @flightpath/view run build
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node build.mjs && pnpm --filter @flightpath/view run build && vitest run --project main && vitest run --project budgets
